verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents grounding its agent in the customer's own content: it trains on help docs and SOPs, connects to the knowledge base, and uses response guardrails that screen answers for grounding. Nothing in the evidence shows answers citing or displaying which article or source they drew from, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: source/article attribution shown with answers, independent or hands-on corroboration that answers stay grounded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every answer is grounded in my own content and shows which article or source it drew from

citations.quote: train the agent on your business context, brand guidelines, help docs and standard operating procedures
Connect Lorikeet in seconds to your ticketing system, knowledge base, and internal tools to seamlessly ingest data
response guardrails screen what the agent says for grounding and policy, with the ability to block, rewrite or escalate
